notes: Rival Slide (defender B), studio project "Rivals", animation Slide, Side view; drawn on the shared Sochetra body with the rival head, re-skinned in RIVAL_KIT (src/art/puppet.ts: white shirt/socks p/q/r, teal trim, grey shorts, teal boots, light skin, blond hair). Defender B wears RIVAL_KIT_B: swap the colours in kitB (skin and hair only, tone for tone: skin mid #e8ac84 -> B mid #b06e4a, skin shade #aa6e56 -> B shade #74422c, hair light/mid/shade -> #463c3c/#282022/#120c0e; polish 2026-11-15, was one step too light). Drawn facing EAST; B slides WEST at No.10, so shot 4 draws it with flip: true -> RivalSlide_west.png (a plain mirror: the shirt has no number). Points are pixel indices. The lowest pixel is on row 102 in every frame; contact = the turf contact used for placement (S0 the right toe-tip, S1 the take-off boot, S2/S2b the sliding hip, S3 the shoulders); studTop = top pixel of the leading boot (S2/S2b row 85 = 17 px above the turf: with No.10 SoleLift F8b lowBoot at world row 81 that leaves 3 clear rows = 9 px at x3 in the money frame); ballMoney = where the ball hangs at the money frame relative to B (above his chest, clear of the head); bodyCom = the body centre of mass (S3 spins slowly about it; the loader also computes the pixel com). S0 approach (optional, re-skin of Run R4), S1 launch 0.30, S2 slide 0.50 (alternate S2/S2b on 8ths through the slow window), S2b hold 1.25-1.45, S2c tip 1.45-1.55 (new breakdown, polish 2026-11-15: he rolls back off the hip onto his seat, ~32 deg of the S2b->S3 turn; contact = the seat (61,102); engine: B_SEQ [1.7, 'S2c'] before [1.8, 'S3']), S3 sprawl 1.55-2.00 (S2c leads into it, so S3 needs no pre-rotation; optional: start the slow spin at about +10 deg and ease to 0 over 0.15 s).
